designPhilosophy: Create a cake shop storefront that feels like an active bakery counter: appetizing, fast to scan, order-first, and specific to cakes rather than generic ecommerce.

visualDirection.anchorReference: stainless bakery proofing rack during morning prep
distinctiveMoves: tray-band product rhythm instead of a uniform card-only grid
fresh-batch visual emphasis for best sellers
cart feedback that slides and settles like a tray being loaded

designFlexibilityPolicy.tokenLockingRule: Semantic roles are locked before exact primitive values.

conceptualAnchor.name: Morning Proofing Rack
conceptualAnchor.anchorReference: stainless bakery proofing rack during morning prep
conceptualAnchor.specificReferencePoint: stacked metal trays carrying fresh cakes from prep to display
conceptualAnchor.rationale: The anchor supports ordering, freshness, stacked browsing, and cart motion without turning the page into a generic bakery postcard.
conceptualAnchor.signatureMotion: Selected products slide a short distance and settle into the cart summary, with reduced-motion opacity feedback.
conceptualAnchor.typographicDecision: Product names get warm display emphasis, prices and controls use direct readable sans roles, metadata stays compact.

derivedTokenLogic.morphology: tray bands, compact rails, and clear stock badges
derivedTokenLogic.motion: short slide-and-settle transitions from prep tray handling

conceptualAnchor.visualRiskBudget: High distinctiveness with accessibility and mobile performance guardrails.
conceptualAnchor.motionRiskBudget: Use small transforms only; reduced motion removes travel.

derivedTokenLogic.anchorReference: stainless bakery proofing rack during morning prep
derivedTokenLogic.colorDerivationSource: Deep cocoa text, cherry jam ordering action, pandan availability, butter highlight, and stainless neutral structure come from cake display and bakery prep materials.
derivedTokenLogic.spacingDerivationSource: Spacing follows stacked tray rhythm: compact product rows with larger breaks between product groups.
derivedTokenLogic.typographyDerivationSource: Display type sells product appetite; sans text preserves price, quantity, and checkout clarity.
derivedTokenLogic.motionDerivationSource: Motion follows a tray being loaded: short horizontal or vertical travel, then settle.
derivedTokenLogic.validationRule: Every UI token must support browsing, appetite, ordering, availability, or checkout clarity.

motionPaletteDecision.densityDecisionSource: Mobile commerce needs lively but short interactions that do not delay checkout.
motionPaletteDecision.motionDecision: Moderate micro-motion for add-to-cart and filtering; no heavy 3D in first release.
motionPaletteDecision.paletteDecision: Warm food-derived palette balanced with stainless neutrals; avoid beige-only template behavior.
motionPaletteDecision.spatialDecision: No WebGL or 3D for first release because product browsing and checkout speed matter more; replace with tray-based layout and motion.

aiSafeUiAudit.paletteEvidence: Palette belongs to cake display, jam fruit filling, pandan availability, butter highlights, and stainless racks.
aiSafeUiAudit.genericityRisk: Reject uniform card grids, generic centered ecommerce hero, and beige bakery default.

crossViewportAdaptation.desktop: catalog rail and cart panel visible together
